title: lsi
description: Runs Latent Semantic Indexing. Computes cell embeddings, feature loadings and singular values. Uses the implementation of scipy.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['input.h5mu']`

modality.description: On which modality to run LSI on.

layer.description: Use specified layer for expression values. If not specified, uses adata.X.

var_input.description: Column name in .var matrix that will be used to select which genes to run the LSI on. If not specified, uses all features.

scale_embeddings.description: Scale embeddings to zero mean and unit variance.

output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['output.h5mu']`

obsm_output.description: In which .obsm slot to store the resulting embedding.

varm_output.description: In which .varm slot to store the resulting loadings matrix.

uns_output.description: In which .uns slot to store the stdev.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
